title: TRACER: Balancing Stability-Plasticity-Cognitivity Trilemma for LLM Enhanced Continual Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.16075v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual recommendation aims to capture evolving user interests from streaming data but struggles with sparsity. LLM enhancers mitigate this with semantic knowledge, but naive integration creates a new conflict. We identify this as the Stability-Plasticity-Cognitivity (SPC) Trilemma, where generalized LLM semantic priors (Cognitivity) conflict with retaining personalized historical preferences (Stability) and adapting to individual interest shifts (Plasticity). To address this, we propose Trilemma-Responsive Adaptive Continual Enhancement for Recommendation (TRACER). TRACER synergistically combines three specialized modules, each targeting stability, plasticity, or cognitivity, while preventing any single lemma from dominating. This holistic design enables semantic knowledge to support history retention and adaptation to evolving interests without disrupting continual learning. translated_title: TRACER：平衡大语言模型增强的持续推荐中的稳定性-可塑性-认知性三难困境
translated_abstract: 持续推荐旨在从流式数据中捕捉不断演变的用户兴趣，但面临数据稀疏性问题。大语言模型增强器通过语义知识缓解了这一问题，但简单整合却引发了新的冲突。我们将其识别为稳定性-可塑性-认知性（SPC）三难困境，即通用化的LLM语义先验（认知性）与保留个性化历史偏好（稳定性）及适应个体兴趣变化（可塑性）相冲突。为解决此问题，我们提出了三难困境响应式自适应持续增强推荐方法（TRACER）。TRACER协同结合三个专门模块，分别针对稳定性、可塑性或认知性，同时防止任一原则过度主导。这种整体设计使语义知识能够支持历史保留和适应兴趣演变，而不干扰持续学习。在五个真实世界数据集上，TRACER有效实现了三者的和谐统一。
tldr: TRACER通过三个协同模块分别处理稳定性、可塑性和认知性，解决了大语言模型增强持续推荐中的SPC三难困境，实现了语义知识支持下的历史保留与兴趣适应。
en_tdlr: TRACER resolves the Stability-Plasticity-Cognitivity trilemma in LLM-enhanced continual recommendation through three synergistic modules, enabling semantic knowledge to support history retention and interest adaptation without disrupting continual learning.
